<function name="SetTop" parent="DVerticalDivider" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets the passed panel as the top content of the <page>DVerticalDivider</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="pnl" type="Panel">The panel to set as the top content.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
